E0939

`#Memo` argument is not hashable (D-MEMO1=A)

What

`#Memo` argument is not hashable (D-MEMO1=A)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0939

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0939: tests/ui/memo_unhashable_e0939.stderr.

Error [E0939]: `#Memo` parameter `values` is not hashable
  --> tests/ui/memo_unhashable_e0939.jet:2:1
    |
  2 | #Memo fn list_key(values: [Int]) Int -[]> values.len()
    | ^^^^^
 Why: memoization keys are the function's argument tuple, so every argument must pass the existing hashability rule
 Fix: use an Int, Bool, Char, String, or named hashable value as the argument
